evaluations.rationale: Game creation is present and does not expose a missing necessary complementary capability.
Inviting estimators is present and does not expose a missing necessary complementary capability.
Starting a round with an item is present and does not expose a missing necessary complementary capability.
Reading all session items is present and does not expose a missing necessary complementary capability.
Selecting an item for estimation is present and does not expose a missing necessary complementary capability.
Adding an item manually is present and complements item list management.
Editing an item is present and has corresponding creation capability.
Deleting an item is present and has corresponding creation capability.

The backlog includes showing estimates, changing estimates, prior estimates, and who gave estimates, but there is no story for an estimator to submit an initial estimate/card. This missing creation capability makes the estimation flow incomplete.
Accepting the average estimate is present; the missing estimator-submit capability is already captured under PP-009.
Auto-filling the estimate field does not expose a separate missing complementary capability beyond the gap captured under PP-009.
Entering the agreed-upon estimate is present and does not expose a separate missing complementary capability.
Re-estimating an earlier story is present and depends on the same missing initial estimate creation captured under PP-009.
